name: University of California, Berkeley
notes: Berkeley's freshman requirement is an overall band of 6.5, with no minimum stated for individual components on the admissions page. Graduate admission is set by the Graduate Division and by individual departments, and is not covered here. Test must be under 24 months old at course start.

name: Columbia University
notes: Columbia's undergraduate page states a minimum of 7.5 overall on IELTS Academic. Applicants can alternatively demonstrate proficiency with a 700+ SAT Reading & Writing score or full English-medium secondary schooling. Graduate schools within Columbia set their own figures and are not covered here.

name: Cornell University
notes: Cornell frames 7.5 as the 'minimum competitive' IELTS Academic score for undergraduate applicants rather than a strict cutoff that automatically disqualifies a lower score — it is a benchmark for a strong application, not a hard floor. Treat this figure as a target, not a guarantee either way.

name: University of Texas at Austin
notes: The minimum acceptable IELTS Academic score for undergraduate admission is an overall band of 6.5. The Graduate School sets the same 6.5 floor separately, though individual graduate programmes may ask for more.

name: Boston University
notes: BU states a total/overall score of 7 or higher satisfies its English proficiency requirement for all undergraduate programmes. Individual graduate schools (Engineering, Law, Public Health) publish their own figures, generally 6.5 to 7.0, and are not consolidated here.

name: Harvard University (Griffin Graduate School of Arts and Sciences)
notes: Applies to PhD and master's programmes admitted through the Griffin Graduate School of Arts and Sciences: overall 7.0 with at least 6.5 in Speaking. Harvard's professional schools (Kennedy School, Medical School, Business School) each publish separate figures and are not covered by this entry — check the specific school.

name: Purdue University
notes: Standard undergraduate requirement is 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 in each section. IELTS Online Academic and IELTS Indicator are both accepted. Graduate admission is set per department and is not covered here.

name: Ohio State University
notes: Undergraduate freshman admission asks for IELTS/IELTS Indicator 6.5 or higher. Ohio State's page does not publish a per-skill minimum alongside this figure, so none is shown here.

name: Arizona State University
notes: General undergraduate admission asks for an overall band of 6.0 with no per-skill minimum published. Nursing and Engineering ask for 6.5, and Journalism asks for 7.0.

name: University of Georgia

higherRequirementProgrammes.programme: MAT in TESOL and World Language Education

notes: Graduate School's general figure is 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0. Undergraduate admission is set separately and is not covered here.

name: Virginia Tech
notes: Undergraduate admission asks for 6.5 overall with no subscore below 6.5 — an unusually flat floor equal to the overall figure, rather than a lower floor half a band under it.
